finding.claim: Unauthenticated insecure deserialization: Marshal.load on attacker-supplied base64 data leads to remote code execution via gadget chains.

trace.note: route handler for POST /restore, no auth filter or before block
params[:state] is base64-decoded and passed directly to Marshal.load
result is inspected and returned, but deserialization has already happened

finding.guards_checked: No authentication, no signature/HMAC, no class allowlist, no size limit. Only file in repo; no before filters or middleware. Not guarded. Note: if params[:state] is nil, Base64.decode64 raises, which only causes a 500 and is not a control.

verdict.reason: app.rb:5-6 shows the anonymous POST /restore route passing Base64.decode64(params[:state]) straight into Marshal.load, with no auth, before filter, signature check or class allowlist anywhere (app.rb is the only file in the repo).
